motions.line: So what would you like this time, Master?<>Huhhh? Me...? A-Alright. But make sure you take good care of me...<>Umm... So this time, I'm yours.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Thank you... No, I'm not just being polite. I can't help but express my gratitude just looking at you, Master.
